Description: Private owner memory with structured knowledge, work state, and approved instructions. Reviewed deployment required.

Metadata.Packaging: tools.memory.deployment.build embeds actual runtime source, removes RuntimeCode parameter, and needs no preexisting artifact bucket.
Metadata.Scope: Owner-private Sensitive knowledge, work records, and approved directives/skills/procedures. No Secret payloads or cloud agent execution.
Metadata.CostAllocation: Activate MavenMemoryInstance user cost allocation tag and qualify coverage. Untagged/shared/request costs, reporting latency, and unavailable forecasts can undercount. Budget is notification only, never a hard cap.
Metadata.Retention: Cluster, writer, required private network/parameter resources, generated credentials, versioned recovery bucket and its TLS policy retained on deletion/replacement. Deletion protection is on. Teardown and old versions require explicit owner disposition.
Metadata.TargetGuard: Every resource/output requires ExpectedAccountId to match AWS::AccountId and AWS::Region to be us-east-1. A mismatch creates no resources or usable outputs; an empty stack can remain. No account/region/engine availability is verified by offline packaging.
Metadata.Network: Private no-ingress database; two local-only route tables. Lambda outside VPC has AWS-managed outbound networking, not an egress sandbox.

InstanceName.Description: Name of the one evolving memory instance; do not create parallel environments.

ExpectedAccountId.Description: Required explicitly reviewed target AWS account; no default account selection.

CallerPrincipalArn.Description: Explicit same-account human IAM user ARN; no default identity selection.

EngineVersion.Description: Reviewed Aurora PostgreSQL 18 patch >=18.3. Verify regional availability and auto-pause/Data API support before deployment.

AvailabilityZones.Description: Two distinct reviewed us-east-1 zones supporting this account's selected Aurora serverless engine.

InstanceId.Description: Explicit stable UUID for this logical memory instance; preserve on updates.

RecoveryEpoch.Description: Explicit recovery epoch UUID; change only through approved recovery.

RuntimeCode.Description: Actual inline Python runtime supplied by offline tools.memory.deployment.build, which replaces this parameter with the source bundle.

Properties.GroupDescription: No client PostgreSQL ingress; Aurora Data API only

Properties.DBSubnetGroupDescription: Two private subnets, one Aurora writer

Description.Fn::Sub: ${InstanceName}: database-only maven_admin credential; no scheduled rotation
${InstanceName}: database-only maven_app credential; no scheduled rotation

Properties.Description: Private owner knowledge, work state, and approved instruction authority
